Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ORIGINAL dark gothic heaven passive-power icon atlas, sheet 1 of a coherent series. Create a precise 5-column by 2-row regular grid, wide 5:2 aspect, ten equal SQUARE cells edge-to-edge. NO text, labels, numbers, gutters, decorative page borders or headings. Each tile has a near-black blue enamel background, a very thin simple worn bronze square rim inset 5%, and a large centered, individually designed sacred relic emblem occupying 70% of the tile. Same scale and overhead frontal view throughout. The emblems are original sculpted high-relief gold/platinum/ivory metal talismans with subtle jewel accents, crisp broad silhouette readable at 56px. Detailed hand-painted game art, controlled metal highlights, dark dignified medieval sacred atmosphere, patina and depth. Do not draw spell casting, energy balls, swirls, neon particles, attack effects or scenes; these are permanent divine blessing seals, visually different from active skill illustrations. Do not copy any existing game's designs.
Exact row-major subjects:
1. Strength: a powerful clenched iron gauntlet gripping a cracked ruby, angular gold wrist clasp.
2. Dexterity: three streamlined swept silver feather blades around a small teal lozenge.
3. Intellect: a vertical amethyst wisdom crystal held within a small golden armillary relic.
4. Vitality: a stylized ivory vertebral column enclosed in two bronze rib arches, small garnet heart.
5. Physical defense: a heavy closed layered gold kite shield with an ivory central boss.
6. Magical defense: three overlapping silver hexagonal ward plates around a violet jewel.
7. Physical resistance: a rugged basalt knot locked inside a thick iron circular clasp.
8. Magical resistance: a blue glass prism cradled inside two opposing platinum crescents.
9. Empty dark enamel tile, same thin rim, no emblem.
10. Empty dark enamel tile, same thin rim, no emblem.
All eight emblem silhouettes must be distinct. Leave comfortable dark breathing space inside every cell; do not cross cell boundaries. Original visual design, not licensed franchise artwork.
